_doc: Curated combinations of (OpenTopo preset, fantasy style, biome mix) that are known to look great. Each entry is a one-line region_pipeline command. The catalogue is the 'starter kit' — a tested set of starting points so you don't have to guess. Add new entries as you discover them.

regions.tagline: Towering ice spires above an arctic fjord. Dark water, glacial peaks.
regions.command: python pipelines\terrain\region_pipeline.py --preset norwegian_fjord --bathymetry --style sharpened --strength 1.3 --biomes ice_cavern,ice_cavern,mana_crystal,grassland --id frostfang_fjord --project C:\Users\josep\test\new-game-project --size 1024 --res 2048

regions.tagline: Active-volcano caldera with ember plains, glassy black rock, lava fissures.
regions.command: python pipelines\terrain\region_pipeline.py --preset iceland_volcanic --style exaggerated --strength 1.6 --biomes lava_field,lava_field,mana_crystal,grassland --id embercaldera --project C:\Users\josep\test\new-game-project --size 1024 --res 2048
